visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair wearing a grey t-shirt stands before a plain grey background, holding two black storage bags: a cylindrical bucket bag in his right hand and a roll-up bag in his left. He smiles and gestures while presenting them. (2) Close-up of a black leather roll-up bag spread open, revealing numerous makeup brushes of various sizes secured in individual slots. A white logo 'Piccasso SINCE 1990' is printed on the interior. (3) The man returns to frame, holding the bags and speaking animatedly with expressive facial movements. (4) Close-up shot focusing on the bucket bag as he pulls two zipper heads in opposite directions. (5) Top-down view into the bucket bag as various items like concealer pens, mascara tubes, and eyeliners are placed into the center. (6) The man reveals a secret divider inside the bucket bag by pulling out a translucent plastic container filled with liners. He holds it up to his forehead playfully. (7) Close-up of hands putting the container back into the bag, showing how it organizes the interior. (8) The bucket bag sits on a white surface; two hands appear and give a firm thumbs up. (9) The man holds the roll-up bag and begins to unroll it on a flat white surface, showing the empty pockets. (10) Hands insert a large fan brush and other smaller brushes into the leather slots of the roll-up bag. (11) The man holds the fully loaded roll-up bag open in front of his face; digital 'sparkle' effects are overlaid on the screen. (12) He folds down a protective leather flap over the brush heads and rolls the bag tightly. (13) A small internal pocket is shown being used to store a metal spatula tool. (14) He ties the long leather cord around the rolled bag to secure it. (15) Final shot of the man holding both bags again, smiling broadly at the camera.
